rpc.name: admin_account_list

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

include_deleted.description: Include soft-deleted (tombstoned) accounts in the listing. Default false (active only). Used by the admin UI to surface accounts for reactivation via `account_undelete`.

rpc.description: List all accounts with their actors, role_grants, and pending offers. Admin-only.

rpc.name: admin_session_list

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: List every active auth session across all accounts. Admin-only.

rpc.name: admin_session_revoke_all

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: Revoke all sessions for an account. Admin-only.

rpc.name: admin_token_revoke_all

account_id.description: Account whose API tokens to revoke.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: Revoke all API tokens for an account. Admin-only.

rpc.name: audit_log_list

event_type.description: Filter by event type. Accepts builtin or consumer-registered names (regex-validated, at most 64 characters).

account_id.description: Filter by account id — matches the actor or the target account.

since_seq.description: Gap-fill from this seq forward. Used for SSE reconnection.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: List audit log events with optional filters. Admin-only.

rpc.name: audit_log_role_grant_history

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: List role_grant grant and revoke events with usernames. Admin-only.

rpc.name: invite_create

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: Create an invite addressed to an email, username, or both. Admin-only.

rpc.name: invite_list

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: List all invites with creator and claimer usernames. Admin-only.

invite_id.description: Invite to delete. Must be unclaimed.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.name: account_delete

account_id.description: Account to soft-delete. Omit for self-delete; another account requires admin.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: Soft-delete an account (reversible tombstone): blocks auth, revokes sessions/tokens, soft-deletes its actor(s). Self-service for own account; admin required to delete another.

rpc.name: account_purge

confirm.description: Must be `true` — fail-loud guard against an accidental irreversible purge.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: Hard-purge an account (irreversible cascading delete). Keeper-only + explicit confirm. Audit ids survive; identity snapshotted in metadata.

rpc.name: account_undelete

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: Reactivate a soft-deleted account (clears the deleted_at tombstone on the account + its actors). Admin-only. Does not restore revoked sessions/tokens — principals re-auth fresh.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.name: app_settings_update

open_signup.description: New value for the open signup toggle.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

rpc.description: Update global app settings (currently just the open signup toggle). Admin-only.
